assets.name: hero-walk
assets.prompt:
Create ONE production-ready 2D side-view WALK CYCLE sprite sheet for the EXACT Chinese commuter character in the reference image. Preserve the same thick square glasses, oversized orange nose, tousled black hair, teal shirt, coral tie, blue-gray trousers, brown satchel and shoes; same inked painterly cartoon style and anatomical proportions.
SHEET CONTRACT: exactly 8 frames in a 2-row by 4-column grid, read left to right then top to bottom. Each cell is identical size. NO borders, text, numbers, floor, shadows, effects or guides. Entire sheet background must be perfectly flat solid magenta #FF00FF. Use an opaque pink background, not transparency.
ACTION: one full continuous natural walk cycle toward screen right, in place, strict side view. Frames 1 and 5 are opposite foot forward contact poses, frames 2 and 6 down/recoil, frames 3 and 7 passing, frames 4 and 8 up/high passing. Alternate left and right leg consistently, real bent knees and raised heels. Hands grip satchel strap. Keep body centered in every cell and feet at the same baseline 84% down the cell. Constant standing-equivalent height at 70% of cell height, 15% headroom, generous horizontal margins; do not zoom each pose. Subtle head bob, satchel swing, tie lag. Feet visibly step, no skating. Full body including hair and shoes inside each cell. Return a real animation grid of the same character, not a character lineup or eight identical poses.

assets.name: hero-fall
assets.prompt:
Create ONE continuous knockdown/fall animation for the EXACT Chinese commuter in the reference. Same thick square glasses, huge nose, tousled black hair, teal shirt, coral tie, grayblue trousers, brown satchel, round shoes, same inked painterly cartoon proportions. This is one action, not alternative characters.
Exactly SIX frames arranged THREE ROWS and TWO COLUMNS, row-major order, equal cells, no grid lines or captions, on solid pure #FF00FF magenta. Wide landscape-shaped cells. Entire character and all accessories inside each cell with generous padding.
Strict side view facing RIGHT. Frame1 upright stumbling after being bumped; frame2 upper body tips backward and knees buckle; frame3 hips drop, legs extend forward; frame4 seated on pavement catching himself with rear hand; frame5 rolls sideways onto ground; frame6 sprawled flat on his BACK with glasses still on and bag beside him. Gentle slapstick, no injury or gore. His feet and hips stay on the same ground line near 82% of each cell. Camera never zooms; STANDING-equivalent anatomy scale identical across all frames. Character standing height roughly 65% of cell HEIGHT, final lying character roughly 70% of cell WIDTH. Do NOT shrink the lying figure. No floor, shadows, dust clouds, extra objects or text. Preserve full body and accessories.

assets.name: background-clean
assets.prompt:
Edit this 2D cartoon Chinese street illustration into a CLEAN EMPTY BACKGROUND PLATE for a layered 1200x640 side-view game. Preserve the beautiful existing warm cream, muted teal, coral and ochre inked painterly visual language, crooked friendly low-rise buildings, shopfronts, awnings, windows, morning sky, faint distant towers and continuous paving.
REMOVE ALL bus shelters, benches, trees and planters, foreground poles, people, animals, vehicles, crates and bicycles. Reconstruct the missing facades and paving naturally so this plate has NO duplicate interactive objects. No lettering, logos or signs with readable words.
COMPOSITION: 16:9 wide view, fixed parallel camera. Sky to 15% of height; buildings and shops occupy 15% through 66% of height; generous continuous sidewalk band from 66% to 80%; road below 80% with subtle curb and lane dashes. Road and sidewalk are horizontal, not a road receding into the distance. Flat horizontal walking baseline at 76.5% image height. Buildings must not cover the sidewalk. Empty pleasant scene to place separately editable shelter, trees, passengers and bus onto. No white gaps, fog foreground or floating structures.

assets.name: bus
assets.prompt:
One isolated game prop: a friendly slightly battered TEAL AND CREAM city bus for a Chinese morning commute cartoon. Side view facing RIGHT with only a very thin hint of the front face; shallow parallel projection, no strong perspective. Match style reference with dark bluegray hand-inked outlines, gentle painted textures, warm cream, muted teal, small coral accents, rounded slightly exaggerated shape. Full bus body, exactly TWO large visible black tires, simple windows, empty seats visible, no driver gestures or people. NO writing, logos, route numerals, labels, exhaust or shadows.
IMPORTANT: the passenger entrance is at 25% of the bus length from its LEFT end (the rear entrance). Draw a DARK EMPTY OPEN RECTANGULAR DOORWAY at that location, from bottom step up into windows. The doorway is roughly 10% of the bus length and 70% of its body height. Do NOT draw closed doors over it; door leaves will be a separate overlay.
Use a WIDE isolated silhouette approximately 3:1 width:height. Fit full vehicle with both bumpers and tires within central 85% of a 16:9 image. Entire background perfectly flat pure #FF00FF magenta. No road floor or surroundings.

assets.name: shelter
assets.prompt:
One isolated CHINESE CITY BUS SHELTER, front/side parallel view, teal rounded canopy with ochre cream edge, two bluegray posts, clear glass back panel, simple little wooden bench. Match reference inked painterly cartoon illustration, warm cream paper-light colors, soft teal, coral/ochre accents, dark bluegray hand drawn outlines. NO text, ads, people, vehicles, ground, shadows, street or surroundings.
Make a thin open shelter with canopy spanning about 1.65 times total height. Full structure visible. It is a game prop that stands BEHIND waiting passengers. Both posts end on same horizontal ground line. The clear glass back should be VERY LIGHTLY tinted and mostly transparent magenta background visible through it; bench and roof opaque. Generous margins. Entire backdrop pure flat #FF00FF magenta for keying. Do not draw a magenta floor, just a blank backdrop. Camera shallow elevated parallel, no vanishing perspective or thick plinth.

assets.name: idle-cast
assets.prompt:
Create ONE character LINEUP reference sheet containing exactly FOUR separate full-body people standing STILL, arranged as a TWO BY TWO grid. Pure solid #FF00FF magenta backdrop; no text, lines, floor or shadows. All stand strict side view facing RIGHT with both feet naturally together on a shared baseline within each cell, full figures inside central 70% of cell. Same inked painterly cartoon style as references, same identities and outfits and same standing-equivalent anatomy scale as their own reference.
TOP LEFT: exact main hero, oversized thick square glasses and orange nose, black spiky hair, teal shirt, coral tie, bluegray trousers, brown satchel, one hand on strap, distracted expression.
TOP RIGHT: exact CHUBBY balding middle-aged uncle with small moustache, cream rolled sleeve shirt, rust trousers, blue shoulder bag, belly forward, relaxed.
BOTTOM LEFT: exact young woman black bun, coral cardigan, navy skirt, ochre tote bag, flat shoes, patiently waiting.
BOTTOM RIGHT: exact tall thin sleepy worker, small round glasses, mustard short sleeve shirt, grayblue trousers, coral backpack, slight slouch.
This sheet is for four neutral IDLE masters only; no walking, no action sequence. Match all supplied references, do not exchange faces or accessories. Feet at 86% of each square cell, head around 15%.
